trust_tiers.primary: Official vendor docs, standards, or first-party product documentation. Prefer these for factual claims and current recommendations.

transformation_and_development.name: dbt Core v2 Announcement
transformation_and_development.description: Official dbt Labs blog post announcing dbt Core v2 alpha (June 2026), built on Fusion foundations, Apache 2.0. First-party source for v2 migration and Fusion GA timeline. Confirmed still alpha as of July 2026; no GA date published.

transformation_and_development.name: SQLMesh Linux Foundation Announcement
transformation_and_development.description: Official Linux Foundation press release (announced March 25, 2026 at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe) confirming SQLMesh contribution by Fivetran, neutral governance, and founding member list (Benzinga, CloudKitchens, Harness, Infinite Lambda, Jump AI, Minerva). Fivetran acquired SQLMesh creator Tobiko Data in Sept 2025.
